editorial.blurb: Eshkol brings warmth, authenticity, and aromatic spice to Ethiopian dining, with owners Tesh and Chaltu guiding you through each thoughtfully prepared dish.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation—seating is limited and popular. Start with the vegan platter for two (feeds 3-4 generously at $50) or go for the Meat Combo with Doro Wot, Siga Wot, and Beg Alicha if you want the full experience.

topDishes.note: robust, aromatic, flavorful and tender—the centerpiece most reviewers rave about
spicy chicken stew, incredibly flavorful with rich umami and balanced heat
